notes.title: A teeny tiny patch to increase controller support
notes.content: Try playing the Delusions of Maximillian Wust on your XBox controller! Which buttons have we assigned? It could be any of them! It could take moments to uncover the vagueries of the controller mapping. Entire moments.

notes.title: Demo Patches and Dent Repairs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43811515/5df94afce238e196a357b3e5a00966f48274279e.png[/img]

[b]“And oftentimes excusing of a fault
Doth make the fault the worse by the excuse,
As patches set upon a little breach
Discredit more in hiding of the fault
Than did the fault before it was so patch'd.”
― William Shakespeare, King John [/b]

Behold, a variety of bug fixes and gameplay tweaks. Thank you to those who have reported bugs and offered feedback, feel free to help out by sharing your insights at our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1951350/discussions/0/6274121610014362812/]Steam Forums[/url].

A select changelog:

[list]
[*] Reduced audio lag/crackling overall (I hope).
[*] Much smaller game file size.
[*] Choose to replay each loop-de-loop level before exiting to reward.
[*] Reminders in pause UI on key mapping.
[*] V-sync is now on by default.
[*] Press "S" to brake. This is our only game-braking update.
[*] Better indications of easter eggs triggers in green loop-de-loop level.
[*] Reduced accidental double-respawning.
[*] Fixed camera glitch at start of green loop-de-loop level.
[*] Swapped one billiards table in hallway scene for a feast with possibility of flambé.
[*] Fixed audio issues with pause menu in green level.
[*] Autosave function triggered by all playable scenes and cutscenes.
[*] Drier humour and wetter fromage (45% MFFB and 68% MFFB respectively).
[/list]

Mac version on the way.
I hope to include gamepad/controller functionality soon!
